free_tier.stated: USD 8.72 per month is the stated floor for a cloud server with the vendor's 30 percent code, printed by the review site as a floor of USD 8.72 for a cloud server; the same offer prices bare metal from USD 134 a month across 59 data centres. The vendor page states elastic compute in 20 or more countries, hourly or monthly billing, deployment through a web interface, an API and Terraform, a free virtual firewall, and three bandwidth modes: data transfer, flat-rate capped bandwidth, and aggregated burstable at the 95th percentile. Traffic within a virtual private cloud is free. No plan table and no shape are printed on either page read.

egress.terms: three modes: data transfer, flat-rate capped bandwidth with unlimited data, and aggregated burstable at the 95th percentile; intra-VPC traffic free
egress.free_allowance: none stated; intra-VPC transfer is free

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: web console, API and Terraform provider documented on the vendor page; this is the only provider among documented hosts with a Terraform path stated
record.chaining: A Terraform and API path with hourly billing across 20 or more countries is the shape a scripted fleet needs, and the 95th-percentile bandwidth mode is the only one among documented hosts priced on aggregate rather than per machine

limits.value: Bandwidth is bought in one of three modes and the page prints no allowance for any of them, so the mode is the wall: a flat-rate row is capped at its port, a data-transfer row at its bytes, and the 95th-percentile row at an aggregate commitment. The USD 8.72 floor has no published shape.
